messages.content: 如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？

function.name: calculate_maximum_height
function.description: Calculate the maximum height an object will reach if it's thrown straight upwards with an initial velocity, ignoring air resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity in meters per second. This is a float type value.

gravity.description: The acceleration due to gravity in meters per second squared, default value is 9.8. This is a float type value.

message.content:
在地球表面，忽略空气阻力时，竖直方向上的加速度是恒定的——重力加速度。  
- 上升阶段：加速度为 \(-g\)，即约 \(-9.8\,\text{m/s}^2\)（负号表示方向与初始运动相反）。  
- 到达最高点后：速度瞬间变为零，但加速度仍然保持 \(-9.8\,\text{m/s}^2\)。  

因此，无论你以多快的初速度将球抛向上方，它在整个飞行过程中所受的加速度都是大约 \(-9.8\,\text{m/s}^2\)。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "If a ball is thrown straight up at 5 m/s, what acceleration will it reach?" Actually they ask: "它將達到什麼加速度" which means "what acceleration will it reach". That seems odd: acceleration is constant due to gravity, -9.8 m/s^2 downward. They might mean maximum height? But they specifically ask acceleration. So answer: acceleration due to gravity ~ -9.8 m/s^2 downward. Provide explanation. No function call needed.
